title: Meet your AI Colleague: instant answers on every shift
abstract: Your team can now ask questions in plain words and get the right answer in seconds, straight from your own handbooks, menus and policies. Anything it can't answer goes to a manager.
lead: Never keep a guest waiting on “let me check.” From today, every employee has a colleague who knows your handbooks, menus and policies by heart, and is there on every shift.
benefits: Allergens, menu items, payment options: your team gets the answer on the spot, without leaving the floor to find a manager.
No more answering the same question fifty times a week. Save up to 80% of the time spent on routine questions.
Update a policy or menu once, and every answer reflects it straight away.
See what your team needs to learn.
The questions people ask most show you where to focus your training.
steps: Open the AI Colleague in the All Gravy app and type a question, like “Does the halloumi wrap contain nuts?”
Get a short answer, with a source
It searches your own content and replies in a sentence, with a link to where the answer came from.
If the answer isn't in your content, it passes the question to a manager and flags what's missing. Add it once, and next time it can answer.
note: Choose its name and avatar, and train it to speak in your brand voice. Next up: doing, not just answering, like swapping a shift or booking time off.

imageAlt: The All Gravy Learning Platform on a phone, showing a quiz question and earned badges
title: The new Learning Platform: training your team actually finishes
abstract: Bite-sized lessons on any phone, games and quizzes, and Duolingo-style learning journeys. Build a course in minutes with help from AI, and keep track of mandatory training in one place.
lead: Get new starters up to speed faster and keep every location compliant, with training that feels more like a game than a chore.
benefits: A visual learning journey shows everyone exactly what to learn next and how far they've come.
Lessons take 5 to 15 minutes and work on any phone, so nobody has to block out a training day.
Anyone can share what they know.
Your best chef or bar manager can build a course without technical skills.
An always-updated overview of mandatory training and completion rates means nothing slips through.
steps: Drag and drop lessons, quizzes and puzzles into a course. The AI Assistant helps you draft the content.
Your team learns on the go
Each person follows their own learning journey, with results and tips straight after every game, and achievements to unlock along the way.
See completion rates for mandatory training across teams and locations, and follow up where it's needed.
note: Pair learning journeys with onboarding so new starters get the right courses from day one.
